title: Personal details and home address
purpose: Collect the employee's name, date of birth and complete postal address, which also gives the country of residence, and the canton for Swiss residents, so the fund can register the employee and HR can post documents.

stories.title: Personal details for the pension fund registration
stories.i_want: every new employee to give their first name, last name and date of birth
stories.so_that: the employee can be registered as an insured person; the registration is rejected if any of these required fields is missing
stories.priority_reason: The fund's registration form marks these fields as required and refuses the registration while they are empty, so missing data blocks the registration.

acceptance_criteria.title: Name and date of birth are always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee starts the questionnaire, wherever they live
acceptance_criteria.when: they fill in the first step, personal details
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked for their first name, last name and date of birth, and they cannot submit the questionnaire while any of the three is empty

acceptance_criteria.title: Date of birth is a full calendar date
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee is asked for their date of birth
acceptance_criteria.then: it is recorded as day, month and year (DD.MM.YYYY), as the pension fund expects it

acceptance_criteria.title: Personal details are recorded for the pension fund
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: first name, last name and date of birth are recorded as needed for the pension fund registration, each asked only once

stories.title: Complete home address for posting documents
stories.i_want: every new employee to give their complete home address: street, house number, postcode, town and country
stories.so_that: HR can post documents to the employee without missing address parts
stories.priority_reason: HR posts many documents to employees and explicitly states the address must be complete.

acceptance_criteria.title: All five address parts are always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is in the second step, home address
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked for street, house number, postcode, town and country, and cannot submit the questionnaire while any of them is empty

acceptance_criteria.title: Address as written on an envelope, nothing more
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee enters their home address
acceptance_criteria.then: only a normal postal address is asked, as one would write it on an envelope, with the country given by its English name (e.g. "Switzerland", "Germany"); no further address details are asked

acceptance_criteria.title: Address is recorded for HR
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the complete home address is recorded for HR to post documents

stories.title: Home address country is the country of residence for later questions
stories.i_want: the country of the home address to be used as the employee's country of residence, without asking it again
stories.so_that: living abroad, and which cross-border questions apply, follow from one answer, and the employee is not asked the same thing twice
stories.priority_reason: Living abroad makes the employee subject to source tax regardless of nationality; a wrong or missing residence leads to a wrong source tax decision.

acceptance_criteria.title: Residence is not asked a second time
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered the country of their home address
acceptance_criteria.when: later steps need to know where the employee lives (main residence in Switzerland, state of residence)
acceptance_criteria.then: the home address country is used as the country of residence and the employee is not asked for their residence again

acceptance_criteria.title: Living abroad makes the employee subject to source tax
acceptance_criteria.given: the home address country is not Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.when: the questionnaire decides which questions follow
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee counts as living abroad and is subject to source tax whatever their nationality, so nationality and the canton are not asked; an employee living in Switzerland is asked for nationality and canton

stories.title: Canton of residence for employees living in Switzerland
stories.i_want: employees living in Switzerland to choose their canton from the 26 Swiss cantons
stories.so_that: the required 'Canton' field of the registration can be filled, while employees abroad are not asked for a canton they do not have
stories.priority_reason: 'Canton' is a required field at the fund; without it the registration is refused.

acceptance_criteria.title: Canton asked and required only from residents of Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered the country of their home address
acceptance_criteria.when: the home address step is completed
acceptance_criteria.then: an employee living in Switzerland is asked for the canton and cannot submit without it; an employee living abroad is not asked. This is provisional: what the fund needs for employees abroad, and whether 'Canton' means residence or work, is open (see OQ-canton-abroad)

acceptance_criteria.title: Only the 26 Swiss cantons can be chosen
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee living in Switzerland is asked for the canton
acceptance_criteria.then: they choose one of the fund's 26 cantons: Aargau, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Appenzell Innerrhoden, Basel-Landschaft, Basel-Stadt, Bern, Fribourg, Geneva, Glarus, Graubünden, Jura, Lucerne, Neuchâtel, Nidwalden, Obwalden, Schaffhausen, Schwyz, Solothurn, St. Gallen, Thurgau, Ticino, Uri, Valais, Vaud, Zug, Zurich

acceptance_criteria.title: Canton is dropped when the employee no longer lives in Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee chose a canton and then changes the home address country to a country other than Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.then: the canton is no longer asked and the earlier answer is not recorded; until submission it may be kept so that switching back loses no input

acceptance_criteria.title: Canton is recorded for the pension fund
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee living in Switzerland has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the chosen canton is recorded for the pension fund's 'Canton' field
